title: Business Bronze Rewards Card: Referral Program - Earn Rewards for Referring Businesses
summary: This document explains the Business Bronze Rewards Card referral program: you earn a $75 bonus for each successful referral, up to 7 referral bonuses per calendar year. A referral is successful only if the business is approved and makes at least $1,750 in net purchases within 90 days of account opening, using your referral link/code.
faqs: How much do I earn for each successful business referral?
